name: NationalPathologyCodes
title: National Pathology Standard Codes
description: National standard codes for common pathology tests. Each participating laboratory maps their local order codes to this standard code set for interoperability.

concept.definition: Complete blood count including white cells, red cells, haemoglobin, haematocrit, and platelets
Blood glucose measurement (random or fasting)
Glycated haemoglobin measurement for long-term glucose control
Serum total cholesterol measurement
Serum creatinine for renal function assessment
Serum potassium measurement
Serum sodium measurement
TSH measurement for thyroid function screening
Liver function panel including ALT, AST, ALP, GGT, bilirubin, albumin
General haematology investigation
C-reactive protein for inflammation assessment
Arterial blood gas analysis including pH, pO2, pCO2, HCO3
Thyroid function panel including TSH, free T3, free T4
Coagulation screen including PT, APTT, INR
Serum ferritin for iron stores assessment
Urine dipstick and microscopy
Full lipid panel including total cholesterol, HDL, LDL, triglycerides
Serum calcium (total) measurement
Serum magnesium measurement
Serum phosphate measurement
